description: Full-scale Spitfire replica mounted on iron pylons outside the ANAF Vets Unit 5 club. Not an original airframe. The codes RN-P and the number 788 it wears were taken from the logbook of Second World War pilot Phillip Bodnarchuk; AerialVisuals records the marking as 228701.
museum_name: Army Navy and Air Force Veterans Unit 5 Spitfire, Vernon
